_readme: KUJI MENU DESIGN REFERENCE: THIS JSON IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH.
Edit text, numbers, lists, the component registry, the screens and page structure here. The script below only renders it.

Sections: app (navigation), strings (interface text, Doc E section 3), data (menu, options, offers), tokens, samples (example content used by sheets), icons, registry (every component and its drawing), screens, pages.

Drawings are written as nodes. {"fn":"Name","args":[...]} calls a component from the library in the script. {"el":"div","style":{},"cls":"","children":[]} is a plain element. {"links":[names]} is a list of links to component cards. {"tok":"path.to.value"} reads another value in this JSON. {"offer":0} or {"offer":"name"} points at an offer.
JSON allows no comments and no trailing commas. If this block has an error the page shows the error message instead of the reference.

bands.title: Contrast
bands.purpose: Whether each text and background pair is readable. Computed with the WCAG formula.

children: Computed ratios can differ slightly from the approximate Doc B §2.4 numbers.

bands.title: Typography
bands.purpose: Montserrat for Latin text and one Arabic typeface for Arabic text; five styles.

children: Weights 500, 600, 700. 400 only for the tagline. Light and Black unused. Wordmark and k mark are images and never change with language. Arabic typeface: not decided yet (F-03); it uses the same weights.
Descriptions clamp at two lines and text never goes below 12 px anywhere in the interface.

uses: Prices are always bold
Text wraps, never truncates, except two-line descriptions
Tagline is regular with its last word bold
Arabic text uses the same five styles; check each line height with the chosen Arabic typeface (Doc B §3.8)

bands.triggers: Triggers (Doc D §8): duration-base and easing run when a sheet opens or closes. press-small runs when a round button is pressed and press-large when a wide button is pressed. bump runs each time the order count changes. confirm-hold runs after a quick add, while the plus shows a check. fade-in runs when the clear confirmation or the search groups appear.
uses: Motion is functional, never decorative

navMap.title: Navigation map (Doc A §6)
navMap.text:
Main page
 |- search ------> Search overlay -> category (scroll) | offer sheet | item sheet
 |- hamburger ---> Category sheet -> scroll to section
 |- pill --------> scroll to section
 |- signature / list card -> Item sheet      |- offer card -> Offer sheet
 |- order bar ---> Order sheet -> line -> Item/Offer sheet (edit) -> Update Order -> Order sheet
 '- Clear order -> confirmation in footer -> empty state

cards.title: Main page

args: Pair a drink with a treat. Some pairs are on offer.

facts: Opened by: NFC / QR landing
Badged items first: New, then Top Rated (Doc D §6)
Order bar shows only after something is added
Arabic mode: the whole page switches to Arabic and right-to-left and the layout mirrors; the order of elements inside cards and sheets does not change (Doc A §2)
Uses: Header, Signatures section, Pairings section, Category section, Order bar

cards.title: Item sheet
facts: Opened by: signature card, list card, search item, order line (edit)
Absent blocks are not disabled; blocks follow the item's profile, never drink or dessert (Doc A §5.1)
Edit mode hides Often Ordered and says Update Order
Price on Selection: footer says only Add to Order (Doc D §4.7)
Uses: Item sheet, Option block, Quantity row, Often Ordered card

cards.title: Offer sheet
facts: Each product has independent options (Doc D §3.3)
A product with no options shows no block, drink or dessert (Doc D §3.3)
Two-drinks pair is example only, not in Doc E

cards.title: Order sheet
facts: Opened by: order bar
Line opens its edit sheet; stepper changes quantity only
No line above subtotal; footer shadow separates
Uses: Order line, Clear confirmation, Secondary button

cards.title: Category sheet
facts: Opened by: hamburger button
Row tap closes sheet then scrolls to section

cards.title: Search overlay
facts: Opened by: search icon
Empty groups hidden; matching rules Doc D §7
Matching runs on English and Arabic text whatever the display language (Doc D §7)
Groups in order: Categories, Offers, Items
